joint_dimension_constraints: Finished bore = actual preplated drill diameter -2*actual radial wall deposition; their tolerances are correlated. Do not independently combine minima as though they describe one physical hole.
Minimum dielectric drill web = minimum actual centre spacing -maximum actual preplated drill diameter. Include relative drill-position tolerance; nominal.15mm is not a guaranteed web.

Minimum preplate annulus = (minimum finished copper land diameter -maximum actual preplated drill diameter)/2 -maximum drill-to-pad registration displacement. Include etch compensation and all-layer registration.
For all12 actual EP positions verify native clearance to the selected TI side-pad geometry with maximum finished copper land and85um outer-etch process. Generic global enlargement is not approved.

Obtain board-specific FR4 six-layer85/70um fabrication quote, actual minimum/maximum copper wall, copper cap thickness/flatness, drilling diameter/position bounds, minimum web/annulus and line/space approval; microsection witness coupons must verify the received board.
Maintain electrically insulated TIM and bare-metal support keepouts. Resin/capping receives no solid-copper thermal-core credit.
